other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage in Cross-Validation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes out-of-fold target encoding on the entire training set upfront, and then uses this statically encoded dataset within the main cross-validation loop. This causes target leakage because the training features for a given fold incorporate target values from the validation fold.

summary: The agent developed a robust and complex solution involving extensive feature engineering and a stacking ensemble. However, it inadvertently introduces target leakage by computing out-of-fold target encoding globally before the cross-validation loop, causing validation targets to leak into training features. Additionally, model performance is evaluated using only the RMSE metric without verifying its appropriateness against alternatives.
